skeleton:
Proper Pan-Fried Black Pudding

British · Easy · Serves 2 (4 slices)

Jump to Recipe Method Troubleshooting Storage
The full English's dark jewel: black pudding — the British blood sausage, already cooked, sliced thick, and pan-fried until the faces are crisped deep and the interior runs warm and yielding with its oatmeal's earthy, iron-deep character. This master writes the component at its own scale, and the technique is one act of restraint: the pudding needs only crisping and warming, not cooking, and the pan that overcooks it serves dry crumble instead of the warm, yielding slice the tradition demands.

Quantities live in the recipe card.

The pudding

- The black pudding sliced thick — 1 cm minimum, because a thin slice dries at the same heat that crisps its face, and the thick slice's interior stays warm and yielding while the exterior crisps. - The pudding is pre-cooked: the pan's job is texture, not doneness.

Proper Pan-Fried Black Pudding

Prep: 2 minutes · Cook: 6 minutes · Total: 8 minutes · Serves 2 (4 slices)

Ingredients

The pudding

  • 4 thick slices black pudding (about 100 g total, each
  • 15 g butter or the rendered bacon fat from the full
  • A pinch of fine sea salt (about 1 g), to finish

Instructions

  1. The gentle sear. The butter or bacon fat in a pan over medium heat until it foams; the pudding slices laid in gently — 3–4 minutes undisturbed, until the underside is deep golden and crisped. golden, slightly crisp crust and the slice's edges have begun to warm visibly — the pudding's face is set and ready to turn. Checkpoint — the bottom face carries a dark
  2. The turn and the brief finish. The slices turned with a thin spatula (the crisped face is fragile), 2–3 minutes on the second side, until both faces match. the interior is warmed through (the slice feels softly yielding at a fingertip's press), and the pudding has NOT begun to crumble — the interior runs warm and cohesive, and the crumble is the overcook's first sign. Checkpoint — both faces are deep golden-crisp,
  3. Serve hot on the full English, with fried eggs, or alongside the bubble and squeak master's plate. crisp, the interior's warm yield, and the black pudding's earthy iron depth — the full English's darkest, most distinctive component, complete. Checkpoint — the first bite runs the crust's

Storage, Make-Ahead & Variations

- The unopened block keeps per the butcher's instructions; the cooked slices serve immediately and do not reheat well (the crumble is irreversible). - With a fried egg and the caramelised apple master on this site, the black pudding runs its dinner-plate form — a documented upgrade from the breakfast plate.

methodSteps.chefsNote: the black pudding's window is narrow: the slice that needs 3 minutes a side is done at 3 minutes a side, and the slice that gets 5 minutes is dry, crumbly, and past saving. The café's standard pulls at the "both faces golden and the center warm" moment, which arrives between 5 and 7 minutes total — and the cook who waits for a visual cue beyond "deep golden on both sides" is waiting past done. Trust the color and the press.
